summary: East kerb beside a cleared lot, cars park here; homes 15-19 m off across the road.

drivers.seclusion: Cleared lot and bush on the east side; homes 15-19 m away across the narrow road and 13 m away at 36 m along.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed spur; cars park on the east edge and the verge beside the lot gives some room.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end-style spur off Moggill Road; little traffic but a busy arterial at the far end.
drivers.convention: Parked cars on the kerb; no camping seen.

flags: Steep: about 6% over the section, 16% max further up
Arterial noise from Moggill Road at the lower end
sun_shade: Trees shade the north end; the cleared lot is open to the morning sun.
cannot_judge: Whether the lot is a building site

best_section.where: East kerb of the short Gordon Terrace spur, beside the cleared lot just in from the bend
